purpose: Teach: 小田/富田/天野/遠山/篠原/藤村/須藤/牧野

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の小田先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — take on Professor Oda's research through your advisor.
lines.style: Clear, measured direction. Decisive on Ren's name. Weight on the key instruction. Professional distance, but grounded in genuine regard for the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。富田教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Tomita's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with quiet determination. Slight pause after the yes—absorbing the task. Steady, focused tone. No performance, just commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の天野先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Amano about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Direct assignment, same measured pace. Slight emphasis on the collaboration aspect. Professional but expecting compliance without resistance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で遠山助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend Assistant Professor Toyama's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quick, respectful affirmation. Slight uptick—showing he's already thinking ahead to logistics. Alert, engaged without being eager. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の篠原先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure to reference Professor Shinohara's papers in your literature review.
lines.style: Steady instruction, almost conversational compared to the others. Light tap on the importance. Professional but less formal—assumes Ren understands the why.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の藤村先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Senior Fujimura in the lab for guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, clear agreement. Slight formality on the senior's name—showing deference to hierarchy. Measured pace. Grounded in humility about what he doesn't yet know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の須藤教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — set up a meeting with Professor Sudo about the international partnership.
lines.style: Firm, final-sounding direction. Crisp attack on the name. The weight of external relations behind it. Expects this will be handled.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、牧野事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application through Makino in the administrative office.
lines.style: Brisk affirmation, already moving to next step. Slight efficiency to the tone—showing he knows the process. Closing with quiet resolve. Brief exhale at the end.
